fee_notes: Standard full franchise fee is $35,000. During 2024, fees ranged from $20,000 to $35,000 due to discounts. Branch Office Initial Fee is $2,500 (franchisees did not pay Branch Office fees in 2024). A Discount Program (effective September 27, 2022) offers 50% of current fee for a second office and 25% for a third or subsequent office. Discounts may also be granted for RE/MAX franchise purchase, expansion assistance, and limited-time special programs.
raw_excerpt: As of the issuance date of this Disclosure Document our standard initial franchise fee for a full franchise is $35,000. ... During the 2024 calendar year, franchisees paid initial franchise fees for Motto Mortgage Offices ranging from $20,000 to $35,000. ... If you qualify to purchase a Branch Office, and we grant you the right to do so, you shall pay us a nonrefundable Branch Office Initial Fee of $2,500 when you sign the Branch Office Amendment.
